caption: The drawing depicts two objects placed beside each other on a plain background within a rectangular border. On the left is a tall decanter with a large, round, patterned stopper at the top. The decanter itself has a series of decorative etched lines and diamond patterns, with shading suggesting a transparent, glass-like material. Subtle hints of yellow and blue are used in the reflections and detailing of the glass. To the right of the decanter is a shorter, stemmed glass, also depicted with subtle hints of yellow and blue highlights, giving the appearance of clear glass. The stemmed glass has a simple bowl-and-base design with similar shading and reflective detailing. At the lower right corner within the border, there is a signature written in cursive. The composition is minimalistic, featuring only the two glass objects centered in the frame against a light, untextured background.
title: Decanter and Glass
